---
name: Sprint work item
about: A bounded story, task, bug or investigation with acceptance and evidence
title: '[Sx] '
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

## Work and ownership
- Type: story / technical task / bug / investigation
- Epic: issue link
- Scheduled sprint/control thread: issue link and dates
- Accountable human owner: name (also set GitHub assignee)
- Reviewer: name
- Priority: release-critical / core / optional
- Status: Backlog (use the Project status once configured)
- Points: not estimated yet; record actual Planning Poker below

## User value or technical objective
Describe the problem and intended result. For a story: As a ... I want ... so that ...

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable successful behavior
- [ ] Relevant permission/error/missing-data behavior
- [ ] Tests and actual browser verification where applicable
- [ ] Reviewed, approved integration/artifact; documentation/evidence updated

## Boundaries and dependencies
Related issues/PRs, blocking dependencies, scope exclusions, data safety and invariants.

## Planning Poker record
Date/participants; independent votes; discussion; agreed original estimate and rationale.
Do not manufacture votes. Split large items and do not count parent and child points twice.

## Evidence and handoff
Exact revision, commands/results, CI, actual reviewer/browser findings, remaining limits.
Link the PR. State what was not run. Follow roadmap #27 Definition of Done.
